capture.scope_limit: live Android cached/sysfs state; no bootloader or recovery transition

comparison.meaning: Equality at two snapshots does not prove an uninterrupted state between captures.

limitations: Enumeration metadata alone does not diagnose a damaged cable, data-capability of the cable, or why attachment is absent.
A configured g1 UDC and VID:PID do not demonstrate host enumeration.
Controller maximum_speed is a capability string, not an observed negotiated link.
No USB role/configuration, reboot, bootloader, flashing, slot or power-control command was issued.
No polling loop or second transport capture was performed.
decision.next_confirmation: After the physical connection is identified, a new explicitly scoped read-only endpoint enumeration would need to demonstrate attachment and a matching device before entry/recovery testing.
decision.next_physical_step: Establish one explicitly identified data path: a cable known to carry USB data from the tablet USB-C data connection to an accessible USB host port on doesvm. If the intended host is another computer, identify that host for its own inventory; this doesvm observation does not describe it.
decision.reason: Both owner UDC state/current_speed pairs are not attached/UNKNOWN; this doesvm host enumerates no Lenovo/Google/Qualcomm vendor candidate at this instant.

capture.candidate_meaning: vendor IDs only; neither a tablet identity nor a fastboot/recovery test
capture.scope_limit: this host inventory at this instant only; no claim about other hosts

android.representation: Exact text returned by the bridge, plus parsed stdout JSON above; no serial-number fields were requested.
